# netskope_service_object_list (Data Source)

ServiceObjectList DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_service_object_list" "my_serviceobjectlist" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Service object description
- `id` (String) Service Object UUID (assigned by API)
- `name` (String) Service object name (unique per tenant)
- `protocols` (Attributes) Protocol configuration. At least one protocol must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--protocols))
- `type` (String) Object type — custom (user-created) or PREDEFINED (Netskope built-in, read-only) (API-computed)

<a id="nestedatt--services--protocols"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services.protocols`

Read-Only:

- `icmp` (Boolean) Enable ICMP
- `tcp` (List of String) TCP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "443", "8080-9090")
- `tcp_udp` (List of String) TCP+UDP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "80", "8080-9090")
- `udp` (List of String) UDP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "53", "1024-2048")
